# CLI reference

Every `mv2` command and option. Run `mv2 COMMAND --help` for the same information in a terminal.

```sh
mv2 [-u ROOT] [COMMAND] [OPTIONS]
```

Local prompt-led universes. With no command, open the dashboard.

## Global options

Put global options before the command, as in `mv2 -u /path/to/project list`. Every command also takes `-h`, `--help`.

| Argument | Value | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-u`, `--universe` | `ROOT` | Universe directory or workspace (otherwise env/current directory) |  |

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`init`](#init) | Clean template install into DIRECTORY/.multiverse. |

## init

Clean template install into DIRECTORY/.multiverse.

```sh
mv2 init [--name NAME] [--template TEMPLATE] [--json] [directory]
```

| Argument | Value | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `directory` |  |  | `.` |
| `--name` | `NAME` |  |  |
| `--template` | `TEMPLATE` |  | `base` |
| `--json` |  | Print the universe's record as JSON |  |

## spawn

Launch an agent in a tagged tmux pane.

```sh
mv2 spawn --name NAME [--harness HARNESS] [--task TASK | --task-file TASK_FILE] [--model MODEL] [--wait] [--wait-timeout WAIT_TIMEOUT] [--json]
```

| Argument | Value | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--name` | `NAME` | Required. |  |
| `--harness` | `HARNESS` | Configured harness name | `codex` |
| `--task`, `--prompt` | `TASK` | Initial prompt sent to the new agent |  |
| `--task-file` | `TASK_FILE` |  |  |
| `--model` | `MODEL` |  |  |
| `--wait` |  | Wait until the launch is ready or failed |  |
| `--wait-timeout` | `WAIT_TIMEOUT` | Readiness limit with --wait, in seconds | `60` |
| `--json` |  | Print the full launch record as JSON |  |

Use at most one of `--task`, `--task-file`.

## resume

Resume an agent, or explicitly recover its missing native conversation.

```sh
mv2 resume [--model MODEL] [--start-fresh] [--wait] [--wait-timeout WAIT_TIMEOUT] [--json] agent
```

| Argument | Value | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agent` |  |  |  |
| `--model` | `MODEL` |  |  |
| `--start-fresh` |  | Recover a missing conversation with a new one, only after every candidate storage proves it absent |  |
| `--wait` |  | Wait until the launch is ready or failed |  |
| `--wait-timeout` | `WAIT_TIMEOUT` | Readiness limit with --wait, in seconds | `60` |
| `--json` |  | Print the full launch record as JSON |  |


| Argument | Value | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` |  | Agent name/UUID, or with --subverse a subverse path or name |  |
| `destination` |  | Universe directory, or a subverse path such as cad-lab/verification |  |
| `--subverse` |  | Move a subverse instead of an agent |  |
| `--json` |  | Print the moved record as JSON |  |

## send

Save and deliver a message to the exact native session.

```sh
mv2 send [--json] [--text TEXT | --file FILE | --stdin] [--queue-only] [--delivery {steer,follow-up,inbox-only}] agent
```

| Argument | Value | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agent` |  | Agent name, or comma-separated names |  |
| `--json` |  | Return the original delivery records as JSON |  |
| `--text` | `TEXT` |  |  |
| `--file` | `FILE` |  |  |
| `--stdin` |  | Read stdin (automatic for piped or redirected input) |  |
| `--queue-only` |  | Save for manual inbox reading; do not submit natively |  |
| `--delivery` | `steer`, `follow-up`, `inbox-only` | Native timing: next safe boundary or the next turn | `steer` |

Use at most one of `--text`, `--file`, `--stdin`.

## inbox

Read messages as sender/content blocks; use --json for scripts.

```sh
mv2 inbox [--agent AGENT] [--all] [--after AFTER] [--peek] [--json] [--last LAST] [--since SINCE] [--wait] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
```

| Argument | Value | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--agent` | `AGENT` |  | `$MV2_AGENT_ID` |
| `--all` |  | Browse full history, including native delivery |  |
| `--after` | `AFTER` | Page --all --json history after this byte cursor |  |
| `--peek` |  | Show unread messages without marking them read |  |
| `--json` |  | Return machine-readable JSON |  |
| `--last` | `LAST` | Show the newest N messages from --all, oldest first |  |
| `--since` | `SINCE` | Filter --all by ISO timestamp or duration such as 30m or 2h |  |
| `--wait` |  | Wait for an unread message |  |
| `--timeout` | `TIMEOUT` | Limit --wait (seconds, or a duration such as 30s or 2m) |  |

## focus

Focus an agent while it needs the user: only inbox-only messages reach it, others are refused.

```sh
mv2 focus [--json] [--for DURATION | --turn] [agent]
```

| Argument | Value | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agent` |  | Agent name (default: yourself inside an agent session) |  |
| `--json` |  | Return the focus record as JSON |  |
| `--for` | `DURATION` | End the focus after a duration such as 5m, 20m or 1h (default: until mv2 unfocus) |  |
| `--turn` |  | End the focus when the agent's next turn ends; for an agent focusing itself or one that is working, that is the turn after the current one |  |

Use at most one of `--for`, `--turn`.

## unfocus

End an agent's focus: messages reach it normally again. Says what waits in its inbox.

```sh
mv2 unfocus [--json] [agent]
```

| Argument | Value | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agent` |  | Agent name (default: yourself inside an agent session) |  |
| `--json` |  | Return the result as JSON |  |


## deliver

Check deliveries, retry failures, or dismiss failures and uncertainty without resending.

```sh
mv2 deliver [--json] (--check | --dismiss | --retry) agent
```

| Argument | Value | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agent` |  |  |  |
| `--json` |  | Return the original delivery evidence as JSON |  |
| `--check` |  | Report failures and reconcile pending, uncertain or accepted deliveries, without submitting |  |
| `--dismiss` |  | Make failed or unconfirmed deliveries final without resending; keep history and leave pending or confirmed messages unchanged |  |
| `--retry` |  | Retry reported failures; accepted or uncertain submissions are not resent |  |

Use exactly one of `--check`, `--dismiss`, `--retry`.

## refresh

Update a universe's definition files from its template (dry run unless --apply).

```sh
mv2 refresh [--apply] [--diff] [--take PATH] [--template TEMPLATE] [--recursive] [--json]
```

| Argument | Value | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--apply` |  | Write the planned changes (default: show them) |  |
| `--diff` |  | Show the differences for changed files |  |
| `--take` | `PATH` | Replace this file with the template's version even if it differs locally (repeatable) |  |
| `--template` | `TEMPLATE` | Template to compare with (default: the one the universe was installed from) |  |
| `--recursive` |  | Also refresh every subverse |  |
| `--json` |  | Print the result as JSON |  |

## update

Fast-forward the running mv2 checkout and sync its Python environment.

```sh
mv2 update [--check] [--json] [--plugin-fetch-timeout SECONDS]
```

| Argument | Value | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--check` |  | Fetch and report changes without updating code or environment |  |
| `--json` |  | Print the result as JSON |  |
| `--plugin-fetch-timeout` | `SECONDS` | Total fetch budget per plugin (default: 120 seconds); increase for slow remotes | `120` |

## plugins

List, turn on or off, configure, trust and check plugins.

```sh
mv2 plugins [--grant {observe,spend,act}] [--set KEY=VALUE] [--unset KEY] [--prune] [--load DIR] [--apply] [--recursive] [--dir DIRECTORY] [--json] [ACTION] [name] [LEVEL]
```

| Argument | Value | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ACTION` |  | list (default), info, enable, disable, grant, settings, trust, untrust, check, host, events, install, migrate or new | `list` |
| `name` |  | The plugin (for check: its directory; for host: start, stop or status; for new: the new plugin's name) |  |
| `LEVEL` |  | grant: observe, spend or act |  |
| `--grant` | `observe`, `spend`, `act` | enable: the access level to grant it here (otherwise a terminal asks; without one, its minimum) |  |
| `--set` | `KEY=VALUE` | settings: change one setting (VALUE is JSON, or else text); repeatable |  |
| `--unset` | `KEY` | settings: remove one setting, back to its default; repeatable |  |
| `--prune` |  | events: delete journal segments past retention now |  |
| `--load` | `DIR` | check: import the plugin even when it is a universe plugin that is not trusted (check DIR --load, or check --load DIR) |  |
| `--apply` |  | migrate: make the changes (otherwise only show them) |  |
| `--recursive` |  | migrate: this universe and every subverse |  |
| `--dir` | `DIRECTORY` | new: where to create it (default: the current directory) |  |
| `--json` |  | Print the full result as JSON |  |
